frame.context_audit.summary: Independently audit datum, native occurrence chain, root-qualified proxy transform2, sampled BRep points, provenance and visibility.

inputs.ref: Body reference resolved in the pinned document.
inputs.sourceId: Stable caller-owned identity of the source definition.
inputs.instance: Full root-qualified occurrence path as string segments; [] is valid only for a root body.
inputs.datumToRoot: Independent row-major 4x4 transform; column vectors, translation in cm. Do not copy the proxy transform under audit.
inputs.lengthToleranceCm: Optional positive translation/BRep point tolerance in cm (default 1e-7).

limitations: The occurrence proxy transform2 is already root-qualified and is not multiplied by parent transforms again; nativeObject local transforms are observed separately.
BRep validation compares at most 16 independent vertex witnesses. A pass is sampled evidence, not exact BRep equivalence.
The caller must supply datumToRoot independently of the frame under audit; roundtrip consistency alone is not evidence.
Native Fusion qualification and scratch restoration have not been performed.

snapshot.capture_v2.summary: Capture an inline semantic snapshot v2 for explicit role/source/instance bindings without writing a snapshot store.

inputs.scope: {kind:'explicit-bindings', document:{creationId,fileId,version}} for the exactly pinned saved document.
inputs.bindings: Up to 256 {role,sourceId,ref,instance} entries. Use complete root-qualified instance paths; [] selects a root body.

limitations: Snapshot values are returned to the caller; no global or durable snapshot store is created.
Geometry summaries, topology counts and sampled observations do not prove exact BRep equivalence.
V1 snapshot behavior and output remain unchanged.

snapshot.diff_v2.summary: Compare two inline semantic snapshots v2 by role/source/instance and geometry, pose, attributes, topology and visibility.

inputs.before: Semantic snapshot v2 with explicit observational precision, scope and entity observations.
inputs.after: Semantic snapshot v2 with the same document/scope identity.
inputs.allowedMovedSubtrees: Optional list of nonempty root-qualified occurrence paths; permits pose changes only for each exact subtree and descendants.
inputs.tolerances: Optional positive finite absolute per-channel tolerances for geometry, pose, attributes, topology and visibility (default 1e-7).

limitations: Order-independent identity is (role, complete instance path); source changes, missing roles and duplicates remain observable even if native tokens change.
Allowed movement applies only to pose, not identity, geometry, attributes, topology or visibility.
Results are observational and do not claim exact BRep equivalence or a specific authorized delta.
